visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shaggy blonde hair and a plaid shirt sits at a wooden table, staring intensely at a smartphone in his hands. The background is a plain white curtain with bright studio lighting. He gestures with his hands while speaking. (2) Cut to a man wearing a black baseball cap and a green olive hoodie holding a phone; he looks indecisive with a slight frown. The setting remains the same, suggesting a two-person conversation filmed separately. (3) The scene shifts to a parody of a soap opera; the blonde-haired man now has a more dramatic expression, and a red stamp-like logo appears in the top right corner. The lighting becomes more high-contrast. (4) An 'old man' character with messy grey hair, a mustache, and glasses enters the frame, leaning on a four-pronged walking cane. He points an accusatory finger at the camera. (5) A man in a white shirt and glasses stands in front of a classroom chalkboard, holding a phone and gesturing urgently as if reporting an emergency. (6) A man dressed as a butler in a white shirt, black bow tie, and flat cap holds up two different colored neckties (blue and brown) towards the camera, looking expectant. (7) A person with long, messy black hair is seen submerged in a swimming pool, holding a smartphone to their ear while splashing water, looking panicked. (8) Close-up shots of several boxes of '娘家大紅麴' health supplements are displayed on a table. The packaging is white with red and green text. (9) The man in the green hoodie reappears, holding a box of the supplement and giving a confident thumbs-up while smiling at the camera. He is then seen drinking water from a clear bottle. (10) A final montage shows various characters from previous phases holding the product box and smiling, concluding with the man in the green hoodie gesturing towards his head and then the product.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male actor appearing in various costumes: a plaid shirt with blonde hair, an olive green hoodie, a grey-haired old man with a cane, a student/teacher with glasses, a butler, and a long-haired person in a pool.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video uses a variety of backdrops including a plain white curtain in a studio, a classroom with a chalkboard, a wooden door for the butler scene, and an outdoor swimming pool.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bouncy, light-hearted synthesizer-led BGM. A male voice speaks with high pitch variability, acting out a casual conversation about lunch choices. Sharp hard cuts separate the different character lines. (2) A transition sound (whoosh) leads into a more dramatic, cinematic orchestral track with heavy percussion, accompanying the soap opera parody. The vocal tone becomes strained and melodramatic, with exaggerated pauses for effect. (3) A series of quick 'ding' and 'hit' SFX punctuate the split-screen transitions. The speaker's voice rises in intensity, conveying panic and frustration through shouting and rapid speech rates. (4) The BGM shifts to a clean, upbeat pop-commercial style with a steady electronic beat as the product is introduced. The vocal delivery changes to a clear, professional narrative style with a friendly, authoritative tone. (5) Bubbling splash sounds are audible during the pool scene, mixed with the frantic shouting of the character. The BGM remains energetic. (6) The video concludes with a rhythmic stinger and a final humorous line delivered with casual conversational prosody over a fade-out of the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Drama -> Escalation -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic 'be like' format to satirize the difficulty of making simple choices (like what to eat for lunch), escalating the scenarios into absurd soap opera drama and life-or-death situations. This serves as a creative hook to introduce the '娘家大紅麴' supplement, suggesting it helps with brain health and decision-making under pressure.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is dedicated to a direct product presentation with benefits, certifications, and a clear call to action.
